name: gizza-ai/file-hash
summary: Compute MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512/CRC-32 checksums of a file.

tool.description: Compute cryptographic checksums of a file — MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, and CRC-32 — as lowercase hex. Useful for verifying file integrity/downloads, deduplication, and threat-intel hash lookups (e.g. VirusTotal). Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
